Hymn 163: Lord, Dismiss Us with Thy Blessing
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
Lyricist/Text Author: John Fawcett
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 163 titled "Lord, Dismiss Us with Thy Blessing" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Jean-Jacques Rousseau and the lyrics were written by John Fawcett.
